variant.title: Kropki Sudoku
variant.description: White dots mark consecutive digits. Black dots mark a 1:2 ratio.
rule.kropki_consecutive: The white dot cells must contain consecutive digits.
rule.kropki_ratio2: The black dot cells must contain digits in a 1:2 ratio.
rule_guide.title: Kropki Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: A white dot means the two connected digits must be consecutive.
rule_guide.item_3: A black dot means one connected digit must be exactly twice the other.
